claim.claim-text: 1. A primary accessory, comprising:
2. The primary accessory of claim 1, wherein determining the buffer level further includes determining multiple buffer levels over a period of time.
3. The primary accessory of claim 2, wherein determining the buffer level further includes:
determining a fit line for the multiple buffer levels over the period of time; and determining a slope for the fit line.
4. The primary accessory of claim 3, wherein the slope is determined using a linear least square, LLS, fit.

5. The primary accessory of claim 3, wherein the slope is determined using an average of a first buffer level at a first time and a second buffer level at a second time, the first time being different than the second time.
6. The primary accessory of claim 1, wherein determining the buffer level further includes determining the buffer level corresponding to one or more frequencies.
7. The primary accessory of claim 1, wherein the speed adjustment is a difference between the playback speed of the content and a speed at which the content is received.
8. The primary accessory of claim 1, wherein the one or more processors are further configured to compare the buffer level to a minimum threshold and a maximum threshold,

wherein when the buffer level is less than the minimum threshold, the one or more processors are further configured to decrease the playback speed of the content, and wherein when the buffer level is greater than the maximum threshold, the one or more processors are further configured to increase the playback speed of the content.
9. The primary accessory of claim 1, wherein the one or more processors are further configured to receive, from the secondary accessory, an acknowledgment of the request,

wherein, when the one or more processors receive the acknowledgment of the request, the accessory adjusts the playback speed at the adjustment time, and wherein, when the one or more processors does not receive the acknowledge of the request, the accessory does not adjust the playback speed at the adjustment time.
